Specify a smooth or structured model component

sm.Rd

sm() specifies smooth functions and structured effects to be included in the model formula supplied to dlnmLPS().

Usage

sm(x, arg = NULL, by = NULL, arg.by = NULL)

Arguments

x

The variable or basis to which the model component is applied. This can be:

Crossbasis object

An object of class dlnm::crossbasis(), representing a distributed lag non-linear model term.

Numeric vector

A continuous covariate for constructing a smooth function.

Factor vector

A categorical covariate for defining random effects or other structured effects.

arg

A list specifying additional arguments. The argument arg$type determines the type of component:

crossbasis

A penalized or unpenalized DLNM cross-basis. Objects of class crossbasis are recognized automatically and therefore do not need to be specified explicitly in arg$type. The additional argument pen can be specified, where NULL specifies an unpenalized basis and an integer specifies the penalty structure (default is 2 for ps). The additional argument add.lagpen (default TRUE) is a logical indicator, indicating whether an additional penalty should be specified in the lag dimension (for penalized settings) to encourage shrinkage of the effect at longer lags. The additional lag penalty matrix can be specified using lagpen: by default, this is a diagonal matrix with entries corresponding to 0^2,1^2,...,(vl-1)^2, with vl the degrees of freedom for the lag basis. diag((0:(vl - 1))^2).

ps, ns, bs

Smooth functions based on P-splines, natural splines, or B-splines. Additional arguments can include those passed to the corresponding spline constructors, such as df, knots, intercept, Boundary.knots, degree, and penalty specifications.

ind, ICAR, Leroux, Convolution

Random effects, including spatial random effects. Additional arguments include spatial connectivity information through map and connect (logical value indicating whether the spatial adjacency graph should be connected, defaults to TRUE).

rw1, rw2

First- and second-order random walks. Additional arguments include cyclic for specifying cyclic random walks (Defaults to FALSE).

by

An optional variable used to modify or stratify the model component specified by x. This can be:

Numeric vector

A continuous variable used to define a varying or modified effect of the component. For a crossbasis specified in x, this can be used to define a continuously varying DLNM effect. For a (spatial) random effect specified in x, this can be used to define a temporally varying spatial effect, when the vector is a time indicator.

Factor vector

A categorical variable used to define stratum-specific effects. For a crossbasis/random walk specified in x, this allows the DLNM association/random walk to spatially vary when the factor is a region indicator.

arg.by

A list specifying additional arguments for the by variable. The argument arg.by$type determines how the by variable is modelled:

ps, ns, bs

Smooth functions based on P-splines, natural splines, or B-splines. Additional arguments can include those passed to the corresponding spline constructors, such as df, knots, intercept, Boundary.knots, degree, and penalty specifications.

ind, ICAR, Leroux

Random effects, including spatial random effects. Additional arguments include spatial connectivity information through map and connect (logical value indicating whether the spatial adjacency graph should be connected, defaults to TRUE).

rw1, rw2

First- and second-order random walks. Additional arguments include cyclic for specifying cyclic random walks (Defaults to FALSE). Only for time-structured (spatial) random effects (main type is ind, ICAR or Leroux).

Value

An object representing a smooth or structured model component. This object is used internally by dlnmLPS() when constructing the model from the supplied formula.

Examples

# `sm()` is intended to be used inside a dlnmLPS() formula:
if (FALSE) { # \dontrun{
# Penalized DLNM cross-basis
# Cross-basis objects are recognized automatically
sm(crossbasis, arg = list(pen = 2))

# Leroux spatial random effect
sm(region_ID, arg = list(type = "Leroux", map = map))

# Cyclic second-order random walk
sm(time, arg = list(type = "rw2", cyclic = TRUE))

# Penalized P-spline smooth
sm(x, arg = list(type = "ps", pen = 2, df = 5))

# Penalized DLNM cross-basis by location (region_ID)
sm(
  crossbasis,
  arg = list(pen = 2),
  by = region_ID,
  arg.by = list(type = "Leroux", map = map)
)

# Penalized DLNM cross-basis by continuous modifier x (using ps)
sm(
  crossbasis,
  arg = list(pen = 2),
  by = x,
  arg.by = list(type = "ps", pen = 2, df = 5)
)

# Spatially varying second-order random walk
sm(
  time,
  arg = list(type = "rw2", cyclic = TRUE),
  by = region_ID,
  arg.by = list(type = "Leroux", map = map)
)

# Time varying spatial effect
sm(
  region_ID,
  arg = list(type = "Leroux", map = map),
  by = time,
  arg.by = list(type = "rw1", cyclic = TRUE)
)
} # }
